title: Scalable Wasserstein Gradient Flow for Generative Modeling through Unbalanced Optimal Transport
tldr_zh: S-JKO：JKO 步 = 源端固定 UOT，半对偶 + 重参数化把训练降到 O(K)，CIFAR-10 FID 2.62、CelebA-HQ-256 FID 5.46，一步采样
tldr_en: S-JKO shows each JKO step is a source-fixed UOT problem, solves it via the UOT semi-dual with a reparametrized map T_k = dT_k o T_{k-1}, reducing training to O(K); FID 2.62 on CIFAR-10 with one-step sampling.
key_numbers: CIFAR-10 FID: S-JKO (Large, NCSN++) 2.62+-0.04, S-JKO-JSD 2.66+-0.05 vs UOTM 2.97, Source-fixed UOTM 7.53, NSGF 5.55, JKO-Flow 23.1, JKO-iFlow 29.1, Score SDE (VE) 2.20 (Table 2)
CelebA-HQ 256 FID: S-JKO-JSD 5.46, S-JKO-KLD 6.40 vs UOTM 6.36, Source-fixed UOTM 7.36, Score SDE (VP) 7.23, LSGM 7.22 (Table 3)
Training on one RTX 3090 Ti: Small backbone 6 h / FID 8.78 (NFE 1) vs JKO-Flow >=50 h / 23.1 (NFE 160) and JKO-iFlow >=30 h / 29.1; Large 50 h (Table 1)
Ablations: K=10..200 gives FID 2.62-2.83 (Table 4); step size h=0.2 degrades KLD version to 6.11 while JSD stays 2.75 (Table 5)
OU-process log SymKL at t=0.5, d=10: ICNN JKO -1.8 vs S-JKO -0.1 vs EM 50K 0.4 (Table 6)
Schedule: K=50 JKO steps, 10K iterations first step then N=2000 per step, 110K total; ~48M params Large, ~0.4M Small (Appendix B.2)
